reference_sql:
WITH views AS (
  -- one row per page_view on 3 December 2025
  SELECT list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'page_location')[1].value.string_value AS page_location,
    list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'engagement_time_msec')[1].value.int_value AS engagement_msec
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'page_view'
    AND event_date = '20251203'
)
SELECT page_location, SUM(engagement_msec) AS engagement_msec
FROM views
GROUP BY page_location
alternatives:
SELECT [p.value.string_value FOR p IN event_params IF p.key = 'page_location'][1] AS page_location,
  SUM([p.value.int_value FOR p IN event_params IF p.key = 'engagement_time_msec'][1]) AS engagement_msec
FROM events
WHERE event_name = 'page_view'
  AND event_date = '20251203'
GROUP BY 1

SELECT p.value.string_value AS page_location,
  SUM(list_filter(e.event_params, lambda x: x.key = 'engagement_time_msec')[1].value.int_value) AS engagement_msec
FROM events AS e, unnest(e.event_params) AS t(p)
WHERE e.event_name = 'page_view'
  AND e.event_date = '20251203'
  AND p.key = 'page_location'
GROUP BY p.value.string_value
